title: Hour Buttons on main graph screen
body:
I have seen screen shots of Xdrip+ that have 4 Hour buttons on the main graph screen
 24hour 12 hour 6 hour 3 hour can you tell me how to make them show up I have 3 different android devices and can not find a way to turn the hour buttons on.
Also will there ever be a way to enter and track Basal on the graph.
Thank's for a Great APP

comments.body: Long press the red xDrip+ icon at the top of the home screen

Thank You that was the only thing that I did not press.
You are the best my wife loves you.
